AEm.caption: Template ID
AEm.doc: Starts with 'tpl_'. Find it in your DocSpring account, or with Find Templates.
AEm.name: templateId

AEn.caption: Template Version
AEn.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
AEn.name: version

AEo.caption: Data
AEo.doc: The values of the template's fields, by field name. Use '/' for nested fields and lists, such as 'address/city' or 'items/0/name'. Date fields take dates as YYYY-MM-DD. For an image field, use 'image_name/url' with an image URL.
AEo.name: data

AEp.caption: Enable Booleans
AEp.doc: If enabled, any fields with the exact value of "true" or "false" will be parsed as booleans (true and false) instead of as text.
AEp.name: parseAsBoolean

AEq.caption: Test Mode
AEq.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
AEq.name: test

AEr.caption: Metadata
AEr.doc: Your own data about the record, such as an ID from your app. It isn't printed on the PDF, and it's sent with webhooks.
AEr.name: metadata

AEs.caption: Signer Name
AEs.doc: The name of the person who signs.
AEs.name: signerName

AEt.caption: Signer Email
AEt.doc: Their email address. Required when DocSpring emails the signers.
AEt.name: signerEmail

AEu.caption: Signer Role
AEu.doc: Optional. Which of the template's signers they are: Signer 1, Signer 2 and so on. Either every signer has a role or none does.
AEu.name: signerRole

AEv.caption: Signer Fields
AEv.doc: The names of the fields this person fills in and signs, separated by commas, such as "signature, date_signed".
AEv.name: signerFields

AEw.caption: Auth Type
AEw.doc: How the person is identified before they see the form. email_link: they get their link by email, from DocSpring or from you (DocSpring's emails always use it). The others are for people you send the link to yourself, or who sign in your app.
AEw.name: authType

AEx.caption: Auth Provider
AEx.doc: The service that authenticated them, such as google. Required when Auth Type is oauth.
AEx.name: authProvider

AEy.caption: Prefilled Values Editable
AEy.doc: Let the signer change values that Data already fills in for their fields.
AEy.name: prefilledValuesEditable

AEz.caption: Ignore Unknown Fields
AEz.doc: Leave out Signer Fields names that the template doesn't have.
AEz.name: ignoreUnknownFields

AFA.caption: More Signers (JSON)
AFA.doc: Optional, advanced. A JSON list of more signers, added after the signer above, such as [{"name": "Jane", "email": "jane@example.com", "fields": ["signature_2"], "signing_step": 2}]. auth_type is email_link when left out. An item with "send_email": false isn't emailed by DocSpring, and gets a signing link here.
AFA.name: signatureRequests

AFB.caption: Signing Link Type
AFB.doc: When you send the links (Emails to Signers: self), a signing link for each signer: api (opens for 24 hours, for your app to show now), email (7 days, to send), or none (make them later with Create Signing Link). DocSpring's emails have their own links, so none are made for the people it emails.
AFB.name: signingLinkType

ALW.caption: Emails to Signers
ALW.doc: docspring: DocSpring emails each signer a link to sign, any reminders, and the signed PDF once everyone has signed. Each signer then needs an email address and the email_link Auth Type. A test submission can only email members of your DocSpring team. self: you send the signing links (see Signing Link Type), or people sign in your app. DocSpring doesn't email the signers of a form library template: choose self for one.
ALW.name: sendEmail

ALX.caption: Signing Order
ALX.doc: Optional. parallel (the default): everyone can sign at once. sequential: people sign one step at a time, in the order of their Signing Step, or of the signers. DocSpring emails each step when the one before it is done. When you send the links, send each step's once the step before it has signed, and make a new one with Create Signing Link if it has expired.
ALX.name: signingOrder

ALY.caption: Signer Signing Step
ALY.doc: Optional, with Signing Order sequential: when this person signs. Everyone in step 1 signs first, then step 2, and so on, and people in the same step sign in any order. Give every signer a step, or none to have them sign in the order of the signers.
ALY.name: signerSigningStep

ALZ.caption: Email Subject
ALZ.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: the subject of the emails that ask people to sign, such as Please sign the lease. Blank: "<your name> sent you <document> to sign".
ALZ.name: emailSubject

ALa.caption: Email Message
ALa.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: a message for the signers, shown above the signing button. Links and web addresses are shown as plain text.
ALa.name: emailMessage

ALb.caption: CC
ALb.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: up to 10 email addresses, separated by commas, that get the signed PDF. They don't sign.
ALb.name: cc

ALc.caption: Days Between Reminders
ALc.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: remind people who haven't signed every 1 to 30 days. Set Most Reminders per Person too, or leave both blank for no reminders.
ALc.name: reminderIntervalDays

ALd.caption: Most Reminders per Person
ALd.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: from 1 to 10. Set Days Between Reminders too.
ALd.name: reminderMaxCount

ALe.caption: Reply-To Address
ALe.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: where replies to the emails go: a member of your DocSpring team, or an address at one of your verified email domains. Blank: the template's reply-to address (the account owner when it has none).
ALe.name: replyTo

ALf.caption: Notification Emails
ALf.doc: Optional, with DocSpring's emails: up to 10 addresses, separated by commas, that DocSpring tells when the document is completed or declined, or an email bounces or can't be sent: members of your DocSpring team or addresses at your verified email domains. Blank: the template's notification addresses (the account owner when it has none).
ALf.name: notificationEmails

ALg.caption: Notify When Each Person Signs
ALg.doc: With DocSpring's emails: also email the notification addresses each time someone signs.
ALg.name: notifyWhenSigned
